gameLocalization.note: Guide spelling variants are resolved against paired Canto VIII part 3 records. Chachihu uses a variant of the first Japanese character; Sigilshattered Bullet uses a different spelling for sigil. Names follow the regular story records rather than Mirror Dungeon or Reflectrial variants. Displayed base levels, averaging, conditional Unbreakable Coins, and source uncertainties are retained.

lead.text: Defeat the adds, then Huan, then Gubo. Avoid excessive focus on Huan, and use ordinary Guard or Evade against Gubo to limit repeated low-SP area attacks.

listLead.text: Defeat adds, then the first opponent, then the second. Do not overcommit to the first; against the second, use ordinary Guard and Evade to limit repeated area attacks while SP is low.

statNote.text: The regular 8-32 encounter. Hong Lu is required; a borrowed Identity is available. Displayed Levels are base values, while Offense/Defense entries include initial Volatile E.G.O Attunement reductions (7 for Huan, 2 for Gubo). Further stacks change these levels. Huan's 60% Stagger threshold is listed as 1098, which does not match 60% of 1824 HP. Exact HP thresholds for the bosses' incapacitation are unspecified.

priorities.0.text: After Staggering Sticking enemies, finish them before Gubo shoots.

priorities.1.text: Generally target Huan with no more than 4 attacks. Have the Grasp holder beat the turn 3 Counter.

priorities.2.text: Watch for Gubo reaching -20 SP or lower. While leaving him for later, use ordinary Guard or Evade.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: Gubo uses more area attacks after your clash wins

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: Gubo loses SP when losing clashes and switches to a special pattern at -20 or lower. Take only necessary clashes and use ordinary Guard or Evade. E.G.O Corrosion also lowers SP, so this cannot prevent the pattern forever.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: Attacking Huan drains HP and SP

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: While allies remain, he reacts to focused attacks. Generally limit attacks to 4 and spend the rest on Sticking enemies or defense.

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: Grasp targeting overlaps with Huan's low-SP pattern. On the previous turn, have the Grasp holder beat the Counter to skip that action. Unredirectable skills cannot be intercepted by another Sinner.

units.0.name.text: N Corp. E.G.O::Contempt, Awe Jia Huan

units.0.notes.0.text: Volatile E.G.O Attunement - Contempt initially gives -7 Offense/Defense Levels. Each stack lowers Offense Level and raises Defense Level.

units.0.notes.1.text: If a Grasp holder is present, all resistance multipliers +0.1. Displayed values are before this change.

units.0.notes.2.text: Becomes incapacitated at Turn End below a certain HP threshold. The exact threshold is unknown.

units.1.notes.0.text: Volatile E.G.O Attunement - Fell Bullet initially gives -2 Offense/Defense Levels. Losing clashes adds stacks, raising both levels.

units.1.notes.1.text: Gains action slots when allies fall. Check attack counts every turn even after removing Sticking enemies.

units.2.notes.0.text: Die when both Huan and Gubo are incapacitated. Usually defeat these first to reduce enemy actions and Poise support.

units.3.notes.0.text: Die when both Huan and Gubo are incapacitated. Usually defeat these first to reduce enemy actions and Poise support.

phases.0.title.text: Prepare Hong Lu and defense against Gubo's single-target skills

phases.0.steps.0.text: Aim for the recommended Level 55 on the main team. Hong Lu must deploy initially; a borrowed Identity is available. Check healing and Pierce, Lust, and Pride resistance.

phases.0.steps.1.text: Support gives Hong Lu +2 Clash Power against Huan and Yi Sang +2 against Gubo. Hong Lu's Lord Identity replaces this with exclusive support; do not assume both effects stack.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Use ordinary Guard or Evade against Gubo. Clashable Guard causes a clash, so it does not serve the same purpose when trying to avoid lowering his SP.

phases.1.title.text: Clear Sticking enemies first and stop Gubo's designated shot

phases.1.steps.0.text: Maintain necessary clashes against Huan while directing Slash, Wrath, Gluttony, and Envy damage at Sticking enemies. Avoid aiming 5+ attacks at Huan alone.

phases.1.steps.1.text: When a Sticking enemy falls below half HP, Gubo may use Bullet Drenched with the Blood of a Comrade. Killing the designated Sticking enemy before Gubo fires cancels the shot.

phases.1.steps.2.text: Do not leave it merely Staggered; check Coins and action order to finish it. At -20 SP or lower, watch for Gubo's other special pattern too.

phases.2.title.text: Win the Counter with the Grasp holder to skip the Unleashed turn

phases.2.steps.0.text: Huan's Grasp inflicts 10 Bind next turn and attracts focused attacks. Heal the affected Sinner's HP/SP and retain a strong attack.

phases.2.steps.1.text: On turn 3 of the basic cycle, have the Grasp holder win against You Must Confront This. Reducing Grasp and Gaze can skip the next Unleashed pattern. Check that the actual skill is present before acting.

phases.2.steps.2.text: If it cannot be skipped, the designated Sinner must handle the unredirectable Unleashed skill. When enemy allies have fallen and Huan is at -20 SP or lower, 2 copies may appear. Prepare Lust resistance, defense, and healing; Staggering him beforehand is another option.

phases.3.title.text: Focus the remaining Gubo and finish promptly

phases.3.steps.0.text: Envy and Sloth work well. Check SP and predictions, take winning clashes, and concentrate strong skills.

phases.3.steps.1.text: Distinguish low-SP negative-Coin area attacks from the 4-Unbreakable-Coin Reminiscence Shattering Bullet. Heal secondary targets beforehand too.

phases.3.steps.2.text: Waiting only for E.G.O Corrosion's self-damage also strengthens enemy attacks. Finish the cautious defensive stage and concentrate damage until incapacitation.

skills.0.effects.0.text: If the target has 3+ Gaze, double negative effects inflicted by this skill

skills.0.effects.1.text: [On Use] If the target has at least 6 Bleed, Coin Power +1.

skills.0.response.text: At 3+ Gaze, inflicted negative effects double. Do not keep taking it on a Sinner with accumulated Bleed; assign a winning clash handler.

skills.1.effects.0.text: If the target has 3+ Gaze, double negative effects inflicted by this skill

skills.1.effects.1.text: [On Use] If the target has at least 6 Bleed, Coin Power +1.

skills.1.effects.4.text: [On Heads Hit] Inflict 3 Defense Level Down next turn

skills.1.effects.7.text: [On Hit] Inflict 1 Damage Down next turn

skills.1.response.text: Both Coins are Unbreakable, leaving Bleed and debuffs after a win. Check HP and Bleed Count; especially dangerous against targets with 3+ Gaze.

skills.2.effects.4.text: [On Hit] Raise the Stagger Threshold by (target's Gaze × 5)

skills.2.effects.5.text: [After Attack] Remove all Gaze from the target

skills.2.response.text: Unredirectable, with the last Coin Unbreakable. Have the Grasp holder beat You Must Confront This on the previous turn to skip it. Otherwise, the designated target must prepare their own clash or defense.

skills.3.effects.1.text: [On Use] Inflict 4 Grasp on the target

skills.3.effects.2.text: [On Use] Gain 2 Damage Up next turn

skills.3.response.text: Prioritizes Hong Lu. Grasp is inflicted on use; winning the clash does not prevent it. Check the HP of whoever will take the subsequent focused attacks.

skills.4.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 2.

skills.4.response.text: A negative-Coin skill starting at 14 and subtracting 4 per Coin. Low enemy SP makes high rolls more likely. If predictions are poor, consider defending with a resistant Sinner.

skills.5.effects.1.text: [On Clash Lose] Reduce the target's Gaze by 2

skills.5.effects.2.text: [On Clash Lose] Reduce the target's Grasp by 1

skills.5.effects.3.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 2.

skills.5.response.text: A Clashable Counter. Winning with the Grasp holder reduces Gaze by 2 and Grasp by 1, skipping the next dangerous pattern. Win with an attack rather than trying to Offset it with a defense skill.

skills.6.effects.0.text: [Before Attack] Increase Attack Weight by the number of Sinners with 4+ Gaze

skills.6.effects.3.text: [On Hit] If the target has 4+ Gaze, inflict 1 Gaze

skills.6.response.text: A distinct skill with its name in reverse order. Added when more Sinners have 4+ Gaze, which also increases Attack Weight. 1 Coin is Unbreakable, so winning does not guarantee no damage.

skills.7.effects.1.text: [Combat Start] Jia Huan and Gubo gain 30 Shield

skills.7.effects.2.text: [On Clash Win] Jia Huan and Gubo gain 30 Shield

skills.7.response.text: A Clashable Guard. Winning does not undo the 30 Shield gained at Combat Start. If the enemy wins, both bosses gain more Shield.

skills.8.effects.2.text: [On Use] If the target has at least 6 Bleed, Coin Power +1.

skills.8.response.text: A single-target skill prioritizing the front line. Ordinary Guard or Evade can avoid rapidly lowering Gubo's SP. Avoid handlers with substantial Bleed.

skills.9.effects.2.text: [On Use] If the target has at least 6 Bleed, Coin Power +1.

skills.9.response.text: A single-target skill prioritizing the rear, unlike Front Line Fire. Even with ordinary Guard or Evade, watch for Poise critical hits and Bleed Count.

skills.10.effects.1.text: [On Use] Gain 3 Poise and 2 Poise Count

skills.10.effects.2.text: ⅠThis Coin only damages the main target.

skills.10.effects.4.text: ⅡThis Coin only damages secondary targets.

skills.10.effects.6.text: [On Hit] Inflict 4 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2

skills.10.response.text: A negative-Coin skill with 2 Attack Weight. Coin 1 hits the main target; Coin 2 hits the secondary target. The main target's defense does not protect everyone; check secondary targets' HP too.

skills.11.name.text: Bullet Drenched with the Blood of a Comrade

skills.11.effects.2.text: - If unable to attack the designated target, cancel the skill

skills.11.effects.5.text: ⅠThis Coin only damages the main target.

skills.11.effects.6.text: [On Hit] Add Pride damage to the final Coin equal to the target's current HP at the moment of the hit

skills.11.effects.8.text: ⅡThis Coin only damages secondary targets.

skills.11.effects.10.text: [On Hit] Inflict 4 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2

skills.11.effects.11.text: [On Hit] Inflict 4 Sinking and increase Sinking Count by 2

skills.11.response.text: Unredirectable, with 5 Attack Weight. Killing the designated N Corp. employee first cancels it. Focus that Sticking enemy before Gubo fires, rather than waiting for him to shoot his ally.

skills.12.effects.1.text: Deal +10% damage for every 1 Torn Memory on self

skills.12.response.text: A dangerous 5-Attack-Weight skill with 4 Unbreakable Coins, appearing at -20 SP or lower. Avoid continuously lowering Gubo's SP through clash wins; if it appears, use a strong clash and healing beforehand.

skills.13.response.text: A Clashable Counter. Winning still lowers the enemy's SP through The Cost of Fell Bullets. While postponing Gubo, avoid unnecessary attacks that trigger it.

skills.14.response.text: Sticking enemies inflict Bleed. Win with regular skills and retain enough actions to finish them after Staggering them.

skills.15.effects.0.text: [On Use] If the target has 2+ Bleed, Coin Power +1

skills.15.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2

skills.15.effects.2.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2

skills.15.response.text: Coin Power increases at 2+ Bleed. Avoid adding more Count to Sinners already carrying Bleed.

skills.16.effects.0.text: [On Use] If the target has 3+ Bleed, Clash Power +1

skills.16.effects.2.text: Ⅲ[On Hit] Gain 1 Haste next turn

skills.16.response.text: A 3-Coin skill strengthened at 3+ Bleed. Focus adds from Stagger through defeat rather than leaving them alive.

skills.17.response.text: An ordinary Guard. Only on-use Paralyze application is listed; the target is unspecified. Prepare enough damage to cut through Guard.

skills.18.response.text: Increases Bleed Count. Avoid a handler already carrying high Bleed Potency; stop it through a regular clash.

skills.19.effects.0.text: [On Use] If the target has 2+ Bleed, Coin Power +1

skills.19.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2

skills.19.effects.2.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2

skills.19.response.text: Strengthens at 2+ Bleed and adds both Bleed and Count. Avoid repeated hits on low-HP Sinners.

skills.20.effects.0.text: [On Use] If the target has 3+ Bleed, Clash Power +1

skills.20.effects.2.text: Ⅲ[On Hit] Gain 1 Haste next turn

skills.20.response.text: A 3-Coin skill strengthened by Bleed. Assign winning clashes to prevent next-turn Haste too.

skills.21.response.text: An ordinary Guard. Only on-use Paralyze application is listed; the target is unspecified. Prepare enough damage to cut through Guard.

passives.1.condition.text: Huan hitting / being attacked / Hong Lu present

passives.1.response.text: Gaze increases both damage dealt and taken. High-Gaze Sinners can deal more damage but are also at greater risk from hits.

passives.2.effect.text:
Prioritize targets with Grasp.

passives.3.effect.text: If 4+ Sinners have 4+ Gaze, use Awe, Contempt【Unleashed】

passives.3.response.text: Adds another Unleashed skill. Repeatedly having everyone attack Huan also strengthens his actions.

passives.4.effect.text: While allies are present, if targeting 5+ enemies as main targets, those enemies lose 10 HP and SP

passives.4.condition.text: Enemy allies remain and Huan's focus condition is met

passives.4.response.text: The original targeting subject is ambiguous, but the walkthrough advises against aiming 5+ skills at Huan. Generally stay within 4 and spend remaining actions on adds.

passives.5.effect.text: When gaining a buff that changes Panic Type, Panic Type stays unchanged. Apply the effects intended for targets without SP instead.

passives.5.response.text: Do not build around stopping the mechanics by replacing Panic type.

passives.6.effect.text: If Panicked at Turn End, reset SP to 0.

passives.6.response.text: SP resets to 0. Do not assume the enemy can be held at low SP indefinitely.

mechanics.0.effect.text: For each 1, take +10% damage from Huan and deal +10% damage to him. At the maximum of 7, becomes Contempt.

mechanics.0.response.text: High Gaze increases both damage and risk. Limit incoming hits and watch for 4 Sinners reaching 4+ Gaze.

mechanics.1.effect.text: Transforms from 7 Gaze. Deal and take 50% less damage against Huan and cannot gain Gaze. Expires at Turn End.

mechanics.1.response.text: Distinguish this status from the same-named attack skill. It also reduces outgoing damage; check predictions.

mechanics.2.effect.text: Max 4. At Turn End, gain 10 Bind next turn and reduce this status by 1. Huan prioritizes Grasp holders and changes patterns.

mechanics.2.response.text: Prepare healing and a Counter clash win for the affected Sinner.

mechanics.3.effect.text: Max 10. At Turn Start, lose SP equal to its value and gain 1 Attack Power Up per 3. At maximum, take 5% maximum HP self-damage at Turn End.

mechanics.3.response.text: Low SP and Power buffs progress together. Check negative-Coin skills and Gubo's special pattern each turn.

mechanics.4.effect.text: Offense/Defense Levels -7. Gain stacks on Clash Win; each gives -1 Offense Level and +1 Defense Level. At the maximum of 5, gain 2 Protection next turn and reset.

mechanics.4.response.text: The table includes only the initial reduction. Use actual in-combat levels and Protection when assessing clashes.

mechanics.5.effect.text: Offense/Defense Levels -2. Gain stacks on Clash Lose; each gives +1 Offense/Defense Levels. At the maximum of 5, gain 2 Damage Up next turn and reset.

mechanics.5.response.text: Beating Gubo also advances his buffs. Reduce unnecessary clashes.

mechanics.6.effect.text: Max 7. Builds through Gubo's shots; each stack gives Reminiscence Shattering Bullet +10% damage. Fully consumed after the attack.

mechanics.6.response.text: Watch both SP and the buildup that strengthens Unbreakable area damage.

mechanics.7.effect.text: Hong Lu's regular support: +2 Clash Power against Huan. The dedicated effect entry uses a spelling variant for Will.

mechanics.7.response.text: Helps Hong Lu handle the Counter. His Lord Identity replaces it with separate exclusive support.

mechanics.8.effect.text: Yi Sang gains +2 Clash Power against Gubo.

mechanics.8.response.text: Useful when focusing Gubo, but not a reason to take unnecessary clashes from the opening.

warnings.0.text: Gubo's dangerous special-pattern threshold is -20 SP or lower. E.G.O Corrosion lowers SP as well as lost clashes.

warnings.1.text: The focus penalty's targeting subject differs between the original effect and the walkthrough. This guide follows the walkthrough's limit of generally 4 attacks.

warnings.2.text: Grasp is applied on use; winning the clash does not prevent it.

warnings.3.text: There are 2 Unleashed skills with reversed names. Distinguish the unredirectable Lust skill from the Wrath area attack.

warnings.4.text: Huan's low-SP negative-Coin skill and Gubo's additional low-SP Unbreakable area attack require different responses.

preparation.0.text: Aim for the recommended Level 55 on the main team. Hong Lu must deploy initially; a borrowed Identity is available. Prepare healing and ordinary Guard or Evade against Gubo.

preparation.1.text: Slash works against Sticking enemies; Lust/Gloom against Huan; Envy/Sloth against Gubo. Prioritize clash predictions as well as affinities.

roles.0.reason.text: Use ordinary Guard or Evade to reduce unnecessary clashes.

roles.2.reason.text: Kill Gubo's designated N Corp. employee first to cancel the dangerous shot.
